title: Pure Batteryman
summary: Batteryman cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Batterymen are LIGHT Thunders that swarm with copies and each other. Batteryman Solar, the newest card (2018), mills a Thunder and makes a Batteryman Token every time a Thunder is summoned, and can copy another Batteryman's name. Batteryman 9-Volt searches a Batteryman when summoned and doubles its stats, then destroys itself in the End Phase. Batteryman Charger calls a Batteryman from the hand or Deck when Normal Summoned. Batteryman Micro-Cell flips into a Level 4 or lower Batteryman from the Deck. Batteryman Industrial Strength banishes two Batterymen to come out, then destroys a monster and a Spell/Trap each turn. Batteryman Fuel Cell joins next to two Batterymen and bounces a card. With three Batterymen out, Short Circuit destroys every card the opponent controls.
